recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future build regression removes `ge` from generated date SearchParameter comparator arrays.
issue_request: FHIR-22495 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core AllergyIntolerance/common clinical date search parameters. It requested adding the missing `ge` comparator to generated date SearchParameter comparator lists, including SearchParameter/clinical-date.
initial_application: GF#22495 was applied by commits b6e3db69721c07eb9e8029dd3bd9d0a9cc4ab961 and 4024936438654eb729bcc2ec9174efb40e69fd93, which added SearchComparator.GE to ProfileGenerator's generated comparator list. A later build migration commit, 9f549566d1346cad7db6d2afca6080d7cebdfbbe, removed the checked-in ProfileGenerator source when core switched to the Gradle/Kindling build dependency.
additional_context: The active core source still includes AllergyIntolerance and SearchParameter in fhir.ini and defines `clinical-date` in source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml. That source bundle does not hand-author comparator arrays; those are generated. The search comparator CodeSystem/ValueSet includes `ge`, and both current CI build output and R5 publication output list `eq,ne,gt,ge,lt,le,sa,eb,ap` for clinical-date. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-22495 decision; a broader 2021 implementers Zulip thread quoted clinical-date JSON with `ge` already present.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested `ge` comparator is already present in the current generated specification and applied-for R5 output. No authoritative current FHIR core source file requires an edit.

related_jiras.note: Analogous US Core missing-`ge` issue surfaced by the Jira neighborhood search; it is outside FHIR-core and was not decided here.
